verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own materials describe Analytics AI (Intuit Intelligence), which explains in plain language which campaigns and automations drive revenue. They also say its recommendations are grounded in the store's real sales, campaigns, and customer behavior, and the pricing page lists predictive segmentation and generative AI features. Together these match AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own data inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how insights are generated and surfaced, plan availability details, and independent or hands-on corroboration (the evidence is marketing-page claims only).
